item.title: WONDER MAN Showrunner Andrew Guest Reveals Whether There Are Plans For Simon Williams To Join The Avengers
item.description: Wonder Man showrunner Andrew Guest reveals whether Marvel Studios is planning to bring Simon Williams into the Avengers franchise, explaining what needs to happen to secure the character's MCU future.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Trailer Brings The Cartoon To Life And Reveals Jared Leto's Skeletor
item.description: The first trailer and poster for Masters of the Universe have been released, bringing the beloved cartoon to life and providing a first look at He-Man and the evil Skeletor.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Director Destin Daniel Cretton Says The Movie Will Feature A "Tonal Shift"
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton has confirmed that fans can expect a tonal shift from a movie he says will be "a new chapter in [Peter Parker's] life."

item.title: WONDER MAN First Reactions Hail "Extraordinary" Series; Yahya Abdul-Mateen II Talks AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
item.description: The first reactions for Wonder Man have landed in a critics TV spot for the Disney+ series, while Yahya Abdul-Mateen II has broken his silence on possibly returning as Simon Williams in Avengers: Doomsday.

item.title: WONDER MAN Review: The Cure To Superhero Fatigue And The Most Original MCU TV Series Since WANDAVISION
item.description: Marvel Studios has lifted the review embargo for Wonder Man early, and we're now sharing our thoughts on arguably the most unique MCU TV series since WandaVision in 2021. Minor spoilers follow.
